description: Type orgDelete's dependency-violation failure. Forgejo refuses to delete an organization that still owns repositories, but answers with a 500 and the body {"message":"user still has ownership of repositories [uid: 16]"} (observed on Forgejo 16.0.3) rather than a conflict status, so it currently lands as InternalServerError — indistinguishable from a genuine server fault. A dedicated tag lets callers retry until the repositories are gone (the usual case: a destroy deleting an organization and its repositories concurrently) without matching on message text.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The organization still owns repositories and cannot be deleted until they are gone (Forgejo answers HTTP 500 with `user still has ownership of repositories`). Retry once the repositories are deleted.
